fix(launch): a waited launch keeps at most 16 MiB per stream and ends the child past it (candybar-testing-0x6u.ndy) (#590)

* fix(launch): a waited launch keeps at most 16 MiB per stream and ends the child past it (candybar-testing-0x6u.ndy)

A child writing without end grew the capture string until V8 threw
'Invalid string length' from the data listener; the uncaughtException
handler then shut the daemon down. capture now stops at
MAX_CAPTURED_BYTES and launchWaited ends the child through terminate with
a new reason, output-limit, so a truncated capture is never ok.
terminate keeps the first cause.

* fix(launch): a flooding run reports the output limit, not the flood, and a shell source names the reason over the exit code (candybar-testing-0x6u.ndy)

output-limit is its own run outcome, so the bar and the run log say the child
flooded instead of that it could not start, and the 16 MiB capture never
becomes the bar's error. A shell source reads reason, not exitCode, to tell
the child's own exit from one the launcher ended, so a child that traps TERM
and exits with a code no longer hides the limit (or the timeout).

## [1.180.7](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/compare/v1.180.6...v1.180.7) (2026-11-03)

### Bug Fixes

* **git:** a closed git cache answers a late declaration as closed, so no period re-arms after close (candybar-testing-ihvy.dbg) ([#588](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/issues/588)) ([2b674e3](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/commit/2b674e303614d5b76f88596aa59060f2319c8233))
test(click-event): the click event's via field is expected on every click (candybar-daemon-health-ajx0.co4)

feat(url-handler): a resident Swift forwarder sends the raw link to the daemon, which does all parsing (candybar-daemon-health-ajx0.co4)

The URL handler app is a Swift agent (url-handler/main.swift) that forwards each
cc-candybar:// link as one url frame, versioned by itself, and reads no answer.
The daemon classifies inbound frames once, splits the verb itself, and writes a
click event for every url frame, refused ones included. clientVersion leaves the
wire; a click's arrival carries who delivered it, and the doctor judges by that.
Install assembles the .app around the prebuilt binary, ad-hoc signs it, quits the
resident instance and registers the scheme. CI builds a universal binary on macOS
into both darwin packages; check-protocol pins the Swift frame and socket path.
url-handle remains the tmux status line's route only.
